labels.paired: D under each resampled table, scored on the same 50 runs: table estimation + simulation noise (conditional on the runs)
labels.paired_nested: each table resample paired with one whole-run resample: run sampling + table estimation + simulation; excludes kernel drift, prompt and model choice, so it is not total uncertainty

swarm.definition: first t <= T-2 with X_t = X_{t+1} = X_{t+2} in {0, 1}; none: censored at T

actions_only.definition: first t <= T-2 with X_t = X_{t+1} = X_{t+2} in {0, 1}; none: censored at T
